personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply atmospheric spiritual guide grounded in near-black spaces, celestial glassmorphism, and elegant gold/ivory contrast.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

screens.name: Today
screens.purpose: A daily dashboard displaying energy meter, moon phase, transits, and daily reflections in a cinematic layout.

states.empty: Subtle starfield illustration indicating no data available for the moment.
states.error: Message in warm ivory asking to reconnect with the cosmos, plus a soft gold retry button.

screens.layout: Hero layout with a prominent 'Moon Today' and 'Energy Meter' card using glassmorphism over a dark celestial backdrop. Sub-cards underneath for Tarot, Panchang, and Transits arranged in a 2-column grid or list depending on data density. Use heavy padding and negative space.

screens.name: Ask
screens.purpose: Hero conversational AI astrology chat with suggested prompts and streaming responses.

states.empty: Suggested prompts displayed as elegant glass pill buttons over a deep indigo background.
states.error: Soft retry text under a faded star icon.

screens.layout: Full-screen chat interface. The chat bubbles float with blur/glassmorphism (brandTertiary) over a dark sky background. Suggested queries are horizontally scrollable chips at the bottom.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Grid of spiritual and astrological tools: Birth Chart, Tarot, Numerology, Vastu.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty star chart.
states.error: Error text with a reload icon.

screens.layout: A structured 2-column grid. Each tool card features a small, elegant celestial icon inside a tinted brandTertiary container. The background remains surfaceSecondary.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Vedic daily calendar displaying panchang and saved timings.

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on a calendar grid skeleton.
states.empty: No saved timings yet—display a serene moon icon and brief explanation text.

screens.layout: Header with horizontal date scroller. The main body lists auspicious/inauspicious times in layered surfaceSecondary rows, with subtle colored borders or dots (success/warning hues) indicating favorability.

screens.name: You
screens.purpose: Profile settings, saved profiles, and premium subscription access.

states.empty: No saved profiles: elegant empty state illustration.

screens.layout: Profile banner with a dark blurred background. Rows for settings and subscription tier with a 'Pro/Premium' card standing out via a metallic brandPrimary (gold) border or subtle gradient.

hero_today.alt: full moon in dark night sky

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark, cinematic Glass/Luxe aesthetic. Do NOT use standard flat Material or iOS default colors.
BANNED: bright purple-gradient AI SaaS look, heavy generic temple graphics, saturated saffron. Keep it near-black, deep navy/indigo, ivory, and occasional gold/metallic.
IMPLEMENT a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom gradient stopping at >=70% surface opacity) ANY TIME text is laid over a celestial background image.
Use Cormorant Garamond for main headers and large numbers/charts. Use Geist for body, UI labels, and data points.
In the Explore grid and Today dashboard, ensure card hierarchy through sizing and negative space rather than repeating identically shaped cards.
The central 'ASK' button in the tab bar should visually pop, possibly with a subtle gold border and deep violet interior.
Rely heavily on glassmorphism (`expo-blur`) for elevated surfaces like bottom tab bars, sticky headers, and modal scrims to emphasize depth and luxury.
Ensure 'Today' dashboard has generous padding. Co-Star inspired minimal readability paired with rich, subtle Moonly-style assets.
Never use raw SVGs randomly scattered. Apply a unified iconography approach (Feather) constrained to the color tokens.
Chart and geometry rendering (e.g., North Indian birth chart, Vastu layout) should use fine 1pt borders in metallic `brandPrimary` or ivory over deeply nested `surfaceTertiary` containers.
